title: Measure Windows CPU without self-generated probe load and report actual packet traffic when byte counters are unavailable.
changes: Sample CPU utilization before starting resource-intensive Windows PowerShell sensors to avoid self-inflicted 100% spikes.
Retain concurrent CPU and sensor sampling on Linux and macOS.
Fall back to measured Windows aggregate packet rates when NIC drivers expose no usable byte counters; never infer byte throughput or substitute zero for missing measurements.
Label packets/s distinctly from B/s in device summaries, network details, charts and recorded live metrics, with bounded normalization and privacy-safe tests.
Avoid repeated expensive PowerShell byte-counter discovery on NICs that cannot provide those counters.
